profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I've been building software for over 20 years — not because it was the obvious career path, but because I genuinely believe the ability to create is a gift, and I try to honor that by doing the work with excellence and purpose. These days my work lives at the intersection of backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, and agentic AI, building systems that think, reason, and act autonomously in production environments.
 
I'm guided by my faith in God in everything I do — including my work. That means showing up with integrity, caring about the humans on the other side of every system I build, and approaching complex problems with patience, humility, and a genuine desire to serve. Technology built without those values, no matter how sophisticated, misses the point.
 
Technically, I specialize in Python, FastAPI, React, AWS, and production agentic systems using LangChain, LangGraph, and different APIs like Anthropic Claude and Gemini. I've shipped systems in healthcare, agriculture, fintech, education, and enterprise SaaS — always with a focus on reliability, security, and long-term maintainability over flashy demos.
 
Beyond the code, I enjoy mentoring developers, thinking deeply about architecture, and engaging in the bigger conversations about where AI is taking us as a society. I believe the engineers building these systems have a responsibility to build them well — not just technically, but ethically and humanely.
 
I work as an independent contractor through Toptal and I'm open to senior engineering, technical leadership, and AI engineering roles where the work actually matters.
 
If something I've said resonates — let's connect!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Since joining Toptal in 2016 as a vetted senior contractor, I've worked across a diverse range of industries and technical challenges — consistently parachuting into complex environments, owning delivery end to end, and leaving systems better than I found them.
 
Recent AI & Agentic Work At GDC3 Consulting I built a full production AI platform from scratch — RAG-powered agentic chatbot, automated data pipelines, React and Next.js frontend, and complete AWS infrastructure. At zofiQ I architected a multi-tenant agentic platform automating support workflows with multi-provider LLM orchestration and custom observability. At MenoHealth I built LLM-based AI agents for medical document extraction and image analysis inside a HIPAA-compliant AWS environment.
 
Enterprise & Platform Work At Syngenta I led the replacement of a 30-year-old bioengineering platform, designing Python microservices, ETL pipelines, and Snowflake integrations for scientific research teams. At Veracode I spent four years authoring 80+ security training labs, building testing infrastructure for 500+ containerized applications, and mentoring developer teams on secure coding practices.
 
Earlier Engagements At York University and Tulane University I built integrations for Canvas and Blackboard e-learning platforms. At Caterpillar and Karius I designed high-frequency REST APIs, event-driven microservices with Kafka, and HIPAA-compliant infrastructure. At ContractPodAi I built .NET microservices integrating Adobe Sign and DocuSign with full security hardening.
 
Across all engagements: Python, Node.js, React, AWS, Docker, CI/CD, PostgreSQL, and increasingly LangChain, LangGraph, Amazon Bedrock, and the Anthropic Claude API.
positions.insights: Artificial Intelligence (AI), Software Infrastructure and +3 skills
